name: architecture-maintenance
purpose: Automatically classify each code change and update owned architecture metadata, shadow and compact map in Python, building missing maps and skipping fresh artifacts.
pre_prompt: Automatic native hook; no LLM call is needed. Session launch and frozen task bind the source root, architecture.md permission and shadow destination.
post_prompt: Inspect reported change types and current snapshot. A stale/failed refresh blocks acceptance. Mechanical records do not replace authored decisions. Run frozen tests after code changes.
